Context: (d) Journey by Air.-

- Government servants not entitled to travel by air may travel by any airlines and claim reimbursement of train fare by the
- (vii) entitled class.
- (viii) Effective from 9-9-2016, the dynamic fare component shall not be admissible where non-entitled Government servant travels by air and claim reimbursement of entitled class of Rajdhani / Shatabdi / Duronto trains. Reimbursement will be for fare after deducting the dynamic fare component.
